# QS-CFW-5798-88 Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-5798-88 (4340)
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-5798-88  
This revision supersedes Rev D.

Scope
This specification defines the quality requirements and inspection criteria for crankshaft blank CFW-5798-88 (4340) manufactured at Plant P2. It applies to all production and control sample pieces for part CFW-5798-88.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 4340 | Per procurement drawing for CFW-5798-88 |
| Hardness range | 25-29 HRC | Measured at specified test locations on blank |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.04 mm | Apply to all main bearing bores for CFW-5798-88 |
| Maximum forging weight | 119.4 kg | Forging shall not exceed this mass prior to final machining |

Inspection method
- Visual: Inspect surface for forging defects, laps, and nonmetallic inclusions relevant to CFW-5798-88. Reject if condition could affect machinability or fatigue life.
- Hardness: Perform Rockwell hardness test using standard HRC indenter at locations called out for CFW-5798-88. Report values and confirm conformance to 25-29 HRC.
- Dimensional: Measure bore diameters using calibrated bore gauge or coordinate measurement equipment. Confirm tolerance within ±0.04 mm for each bore. Record measurement results in the inspection record for CFW-5798-88.
- Weight verification: Weigh completed forging blank prior to machining. Confirm weight does not exceed 119.4 kg. Record actual weight on traveler.

Nonconformance handling
- Segregate any blank that fails to meet the table requirements and mark as nonconforming for CFW-5798-88.
- Initiate containment to prevent use in production pending disposition.
- Disposition options include rework if feasible without violating requirements for CFW-5798-88, or scrap. Document disposition decision and attach inspection records.
- Root cause and corrective action must be documented and retained with the lot records for CFW-5798-88.
